name: vace
description: fakinflu RunPod serverless worker: Maquette decor layer (Couche decor). Wan 2.2 VACE Fun A14B (fp8 scaled, high + low noise experts) on ComfyUI native nodes (WanVaceToVideo), models baked. Inputs: Maquette passes (depth, clay, pose) as control video, optional mask + base layer, 0-4 global reference images, prompt. Windows of 81 frames, 9 carried over. Outputs: result.mp4, preview.jpg.
